# Ivan Kovačević

> Serbian double bassist, bandleader and arranger based in Barcelona (Spain). Balkan, jazz and rhythm & blues. Available for concerts, festivals, recordings and private events.

## Key facts
- Name: Ivan Kovačević
- Born: 16 April 1977, Belgrade, Serbia
- Based in: Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain
- Instruments: double bass (contrabass)
- Genres: Balkan, Klezmer, Gypsy jazz, jazz, rhythm & blues, rockabilly
- Website languages: English, Catalan, Spanish, Serbian (EN / CA / ES / SR)
- Booking contact: ivandoublebass@gmail.com
- Website: https://ivankovacevic.com/

## Bands and projects
- Barcelona Big Blues Band — founder, director, arranger and double bass
- Barcelona Gipsy balKan Orchestra (BGKO) — founding member
- Los Mambo Jambo — double bass
- Bernat Font Trio — double bass
- Ivan Kovačević 5 Spots — leader
- Bratia (founding member)
- Lazy Jumpers, The Nu Niles, Down Home — collaborations
- Endorsed by D'Addario strings
